title: Шеф заперт в холодильнике  (The Chef Locked in the Walk-in Fridge)

segments.t: Hoping the cold temperature will slow down the fugu toxin and keep Chef Barinov from getting behind the wheel, Fedya tricks him into stepping inside the walk-in refrigerator. Leaving him a crate of cognac so he will not freeze, the cooks bolt the heavy door shut.
Шеф, я что-то не могу разобраться.
Как ты мог этого не знать?
Федя, здесь же на коробке написано.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
Шеф, я что-то не могу разобраться.
'Chef, I cannot seem to figure this out.' Barinov mentions that he cannot seem to figure this out so Fedya sees what is at stake.
'Oh, Fyodor, Fyodor.' Around the plan and shift, Fedya sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.
'Which means.' With the plan and conversation in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Как ты мог этого не знать?
'How could you not know that?' Asking how Barinov not know could is how Fedya puts Barinov on the spot.
'He is going to freeze in there.' Being going to freeze in there is how Barinov lays out the situation for Fedya.
'I left him a crate of cognac.' Adding that he left him a crate of cognac fills in the missing piece for Barinov.
'He will not freeze.' Saying that he will not freeze is how Barinov sets the tone with Fedya.
'That is my cognac.' Since that is his cognac, Fedya does not waste words on excuses. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'Better the cognac than...' Over the room and the moment, Barinov answers Fedya without a second thought.
Федя, здесь же на коробке написано.
'Fedya, it is written right here on the box.' Fedya reminds Barinov that it is written right here on the box before the moment passes.

'Fedya, what kind of joke is this?' Asking whether what kind of joke is this puts Fedya right on the defensive. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Fedya, what is going on?' Asking what going is is how Fedya puts Barinov on the spot. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Come on, open up right now!' Once Fedya should come on open up right now, Barinov makes sure Fedya hears every word. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Шеф, я что-то не могу разобраться.
Как ты мог этого не знать?
Федя, здесь же на коробке написано.
That wraps up this scene as to keep the supposedly poisoned Chef from driving off, Fedya and Senya lock Viktor Petrovich inside the walk-in refrigerator with a crate of cognac. See you next time!
